content:
In addition to "Awaiting review" and "Awaiting author", should we have an "Awaiting dependencies" label? This would be set by reviewers when a roadmap proposal looks good, but cannot be merged yet since it depends on others still under review. When the dependencies are merged, it's the author's responsibility to set it back to "Awaiting review."

See PRs 243-256 for a bunch of PRs with dependencies (these are not yet ready for "Awaiting dependencies," but I hope they will be soon).
I think anyone can make a label, so I just made it. If people dont actually want this then we can remove it I guess.
I would make it lower case for consistency.
